name: facebookresearch_spdl/tools/autoresearch/utils/platform/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_spdl/tools/autoresearch.create_agent: create a Claude, Codex, or Mock coding agent using the _create_agent factory function
facebookresearch_spdl/tools/autoresearch.run_claude_agent: run a Claude-backed coding agent with a prompt, workdir, and phase name
facebookresearch_spdl/tools/autoresearch.run_codex_agent: run a Codex-backed coding agent via subprocess with prompt logging and output capture
facebookresearch_spdl/tools/autoresearch.parse_agent_result: parse an agent response string into an _AgentResult with extracted JSON or parse errors
facebookresearch_spdl/tools/autoresearch.extract_json_block: extract a JSON object from a markdown code block or raw JSON string in agent output

facebookresearch_spdl/tools/autoresearch.create_platform_from_string: create an AutoresearchPlatform by passing a platform name string like 'local' to create_platform
facebookresearch_spdl/tools/autoresearch.create_platform_from_dict: create an AutoresearchPlatform by passing a config dict with a 'platform' key to create_platform
facebookresearch_spdl/tools/autoresearch.create_platform_with_workdir: create an AutoresearchPlatform with a custom working directory by passing a Path to workdir
facebookresearch_spdl/tools/autoresearch.create_platform_auto_kind: create an AutoresearchPlatform using the default 'auto' kind when no platform key is provided in config
facebookresearch_spdl/tools/autoresearch.review_create_platform: review the create_platform factory function that validates config, resolves providers, and returns an AutoresearchPlatform

facebookresearch_spdl/tools/autoresearch.launch_local_experiment_job: launch a local subprocess experiment job with a shell command and capture stdout and stderr logs
facebookresearch_spdl/tools/autoresearch.check_local_job_status: check the status of a running local job and return SUCCEEDED FAILED or RUNNING
facebookresearch_spdl/tools/autoresearch.collect_local_evidence: collect metrics evidence from local job logs including stdout stderr and exit code
facebookresearch_spdl/tools/autoresearch.extract_traceback_from_text: extract a Python traceback block from arbitrary text output for error diagnosis
facebookresearch_spdl/tools/autoresearch.summarize_error_from_text: summarize errors from text output by finding the most relevant error or exception line

facebookresearch_spdl/tools/autoresearch.resolve_providers: resolve all autoresearch platform providers including builtin and extension providers discovered via entry points
facebookresearch_spdl/tools/autoresearch.find_provider: find a specific autoresearch platform provider by name or auto-select the highest priority available provider
facebookresearch_spdl/tools/autoresearch.discover_extension_providers: discover autoresearch platform extension providers from environment variables and Python entry points
facebookresearch_spdl/tools/autoresearch.validate_common_config: validate an autoresearch configuration dict checking agent kind, source directory, and pipeline script paths
facebookresearch_spdl/tools/autoresearch.create_agent_for_config: create a coding agent instance from an autoresearch configuration dict with the specified agent kind

facebookresearch_spdl/tools/autoresearch.create_AutoresearchPlatform: create an AutoresearchPlatform instance aggregating workspace, artifacts, execution, evidence, and agent capabilities
facebookresearch_spdl/tools/autoresearch.build_Artifacts_protocol: build an implementation of the _Artifacts protocol to compile or resolve experiment artifacts
facebookresearch_spdl/tools/autoresearch.test_Execution_protocol: test the _Execution protocol methods to launch, poll, and cancel experiment jobs
facebookresearch_spdl/tools/autoresearch.review_Workspace_protocol: review the _Workspace protocol for source-control operations like detect, commit, and goto
facebookresearch_spdl/tools/autoresearch.summarize_MetricsEvidence: summarize the _MetricsEvidence dataclass fields for system metrics, pipeline stats, and log paths
